Universe at Scale

Four maps, from the moons of the giant planets out to the edge of the observable universe. Objects sit where real measurements put them. Pick a map, then drag, zoom and click anything to learn about it.

Callisto's orbit  1.88 million km
Neptune from the Sun  4.5 billion km
Proxima Centauri  4.24 light-years
Galactic centre  27,000 light-years
Observable universe  46.5 billion ly

From Earth to the Edge of the Universe

The Solar System and the galaxy map joined into one space. Start at Earth and keep scrolling out: the Moon, the planets, the Oort cloud, the nearest stars, the Milky Way, and on to the edge of everything we can see.

  • Range  12,742 km → 93 billion light-years
  • Sky  9,502 real stars · zodiac figures in true 3D

The Solar System

The Sun, all eight planets and the five dwarf planets in one true-to-scale space, at their real positions today from NASA JPL orbital data. Zoom from the whole system down to a single moon.

  • Neptune's orbit  165 years, 30 AU out
  • Sunlight to Neptune  just over 4 hours
